title: How long does each event take?
prompt: Place each event by how long it lasts, from the briefest to the longest.

items.label: A blink of an eye
items.fact: A single blink lasts about a tenth of a second — you do it 15–20 times a minute without noticing.

items.label: One heartbeat
items.fact: A resting heart beats roughly once a second — about 100,000 times a day.

items.label: Microwaving popcorn
items.fact: Most bags are engineered to finish in under three minutes before the kernels scorch.

items.label: A sitcom episode
items.fact: A 'half-hour' sitcom is really about 22 minutes — the rest is advertising.

items.label: A feature film
items.fact: The average Hollywood feature has crept past two hours over recent decades.

items.label: A flight from Cleveland to New York City
items.fact: The gate-to-gate hop is about 90 minutes; the actual airtime is closer to 70.
